summary: Defines the INFO method for the Session Initiation Protocol (SIP), which lets endpoints send application-level information during an existing session, along with an Info Package mechanism for defining what such messages carry. It also keeps a legacy mode compatible with earlier use. It is a proposed standard and obsoletes RFC 2976.

eli5.summary: During a phone call you can pass little notes to each other. This sets the rules for what the notes can say and how to label them.
